name: Seminar Course
description:
This seminar course enables students to apply their understanding of rural value chain challenges in the agricultural sector by identifying a real-world problem faced by farmers, FPOs, or agri-entrepreneurs. Students will engage in field-based inquiry, stakeholder consultation, and system mapping to co-develop a low-cost, scalable, and context-specific technological solution. The emphasis is on sustainability, inclusivity, and feasibility.
After this course, the student will be able to 
Applying interdisciplinary knowledge to real-life rural contexts
Enhancing problem-solving and design thinking skills
Fostering innovation for grassroots impact
Promoting ethical, affordable, and locally adaptable agri-tech interventions
